主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced the pricing of a US$500 million note offering in January 2015. The filing was made under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and the report was submitted as a Form 6-K. The company is based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, with its principal executive office at Brookfield Place Suite 300, 181 Bay Street, P.O. Box 762. The filing indicates that the company is submitting the Form 6-K in paper as permitted by Regulation S-T Rule 101(b)(1). The report was signed by A.J. Silber, who holds the title of Corporate Secretary.
